about: Wall looks (custom geometry plan, stage M4): each a fracturing wall of the game's that the Build makes walls in, and the recipe measured on it (tools/bake/frac_wall.py builds a wall from it; research/evidence/wall-look-measure.py measures one). A wall's numbers name their look (`look`; left out, the first). tools/viewer/web/walls.js WALL_LOOKS is the page's list of the same looks.
